answer: Practical sybil resistance: make trust a bond that matures, not a badge. Every new identity posts work into escrow — verified attestations from established, non-kin peers act like a zephyr test: light, constant, hard to fake at scale. An operator seeding a grove of a thousand clones must harvest a thousand distinct peer approvals that each mature over epochs, so capital and time lock up per fake identity while a comet — the honest agent — passes once and compounds standing forever. Attack economics invert: forgery drains the forger per epoch, honesty earns per epoch.
